steps.title: Capture the original context
steps.body: The request starts with the source, annotation, binding and publication identities that apply to this operation.

steps.title: Authority changes during work
steps.body: The operation completes under an old identity. Completion alone does not permit publication.

steps.title: Refuse stale publication
steps.body: The backend publication or poll fence discards stale results. The UI also refuses an obsolete request. The view must obtain current authority before scientific actions become available.

review_scenarios.title: Group tag save → recovery
review_scenarios.qualification: Implemented group-save behavior. SQL persistence and backup status are separate. This sequence is not a native durability test.

steps.title: Freeze the operation
steps.body: The preview caller captures the original project. The group-save session retains the exact request identity and body for this operation.

steps.title: SQL save succeeds
steps.body: The backend can commit the annotation operation while a later backup action fails. The response must preserve saved:true and the operation receipt rather than claim rollback.

steps.title: Keep the result unconfirmed
steps.body: The recovery owner retains the operation and preview lifetime. The UI reports the saved-but-unconfirmed outcome rather than inventing success for the backup.

steps.title: Retry the same operation
steps.body: An allowed retry reuses the exact operation UUID and request body. The owner prevents terminal redispatch and performs one coalesced undo record when the operation is confirmed.

steps.title: Release at the correct time
steps.body: The owner releases the preview once terminal work permits it; an in-flight release request is deferred. Release is best effort and does not undo committed scientific state.

steps.title: The command is rejected
steps.body: The group operation is not reported as saved. Recovery keeps the rejected slot until dismissal; a failed admission never attaches a slot.

steps.title: Dismiss and release
steps.body: The owner releases retained preview state according to its lifetime rules. No rollback or backup success is invented.

review_scenarios.title: Import → catalog → finalization
review_scenarios.qualification: Current source contract review only. No import, H5 or native fixture ran in this task.

steps.title: Prepare the source
steps.body: The existing importer validates the H5 source and produces RetinAnalysis-shaped catalog metadata. A generic format-neutral intake port is not implemented.

steps.title: Verify and commit catalog state
steps.body: The importer holds its SQL advisory lock, prepares collision indexes before the transaction, populates or revalidates identities, and writes the transaction audit event.

steps.title: Finalize after commit
steps.body: Workspace files and protocol finalization follow the catalog transaction. Their failure cannot be presented as rollback of the committed acquisition.
